claim: Data-driven probabilistic forecasting on the Karnali increased lead time from 2-3 h to 7-8 h; communicating probabilistic forecasts to the last mile is a challenge.
quoted_support: The successful application of the forecast methodology to the flood-prone Karnali River basin in western Nepal is outlined, increasing lead times from 2–3 to 7–8 h.
stance_target: Warning dissemination gaps are a key improvement area
